{{Top|leg}}
An '''Oseoni greatcoat''' was a style of [[Greatcoat/Legends|greatcoat]] favored by society's upper class. The correct way to fold an Oseoni greatcoat was part of the knowledge that a [[Butler droid/Legends|butler droid]] such as the [[JV-Z1/D butler droid]] was programmed with.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
